content: claude -p: --tools restricts built-ins; --disallowedTools 'mcp__*' removes MCP; --strict-mcp-config + --mcp-config; --max-turns; --output-format json with --json-schema returns structured_output (check presence); --permission-mode dontAsk denies anything that would prompt; --permission-prompts none for unattended; --no-session-persistence. --bare skips plugins/hooks AND never reads OAuth/keychain so needs API key -> must NOT be used; docs say bare will become default for -p in future. Without --bare, -p runs project .claude/settings.json hooks and .mcp.json with no trust dialog. Auth precedence: cloud provider vars > ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN > ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (always used in -p when present) > apiKeyHelper > CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN > subscription /login. SIGTERM exit 143.
